title: Analytical Procedures (Assay SM1) [Assay][CP-4]
description: Core quality information (2.3.3.AP) for Analytical Procedures (Assay SM1) [Assay][CP-4].

action.title: Column
action.description: Silica C18, 3.5 µm, 250 x 4.6 mm or equivalent

action.title: Test solution
action.description: Approximately 1.0 mg/ml of sample to be examined in diluent (Acentonitrile:phosphate buffer 1:4)

action.title: Reference solution
action.description: Approximately 1.0 mg/ml of CP-4 standard in diluent.

action.title: System Suitability Criteria
action.description: Theoretical plates > 3200 Reproducibility (n=5) < 0.73 %                                      RSD of  ≤ 1% for n≥ 5 is desirable.

action.title: Calculation
action.description: The content of CP-4 is calculated according to the following formula: (Am*Cs/As*Cm)*V Am =   Peak area value of CP-4 in the test solution As =   Peak area value of CP-4 in the reference solution Cs =   Weight of CP-4 (mg) in the reference solution Cm =   Weight of CP-4 (mg) in the test solution V =     Known concentration of CP-4 standard, in % Report the result “as is”.
